desc: **Derivation task:** cost identity, ≤1 flip (≤2 for A=B=1), offs-descending-then-ons-ascending ordering, closed form cost(T) verified on Sample 1 (16).
**Exchange-argument task:** for fixed t=|T| the optimal T is the t largest-C elements of R, so a single sweep over t suffices.
**Core implementation + sweep task:** full program (parsing, P/Q/R construction, prefix sums, base minpairs, descending sweep over R with bisect incremental updates, min over t, print).

**Testing task:** brute force (Dijkstra over 2^N states) vs. solution on random cases + Samples 1–3 (16, 0, 2867) and edge cases (N=1, A=B, empty P/Q/R, all-equal C); flip-count minimality proof gap closed.
